title: Market Making with Limit and Market Orders (Guilbaud & Pham)
holding_period: seconds; continuous quoting with occasional market-order flattening
signal_frequency: per tick-time event; discrete placement decisions
data_requirements: tick-by-tick level-1 data with spread in tick multiples
fill records tagged by spread state and quote placement, for Cox intensity calibration
event timestamps for the tick-time clock intensity, estimated hourly
exchange tick size and fee/rebate schedule

sources.citation: Guilbaud, F., & Pham, H. Optimal high frequency trading with limit and market orders. arXiv:1106.5040 (24 June 2011 draft); published in Quantitative Finance 13(1), 79-94 (2013).
Avellaneda, M., & Stoikov, S. (2008). High-frequency trading in a limit order book. Quantitative Finance, 8(3), 217-224. (The parent model.)
Guéant, O., Lehalle, C.-A., & Fernandez-Tapia, J. Dealing with the Inventory Risk. arXiv:1105.3115.
